name: apograph
description: Autocompletion of terms and sentences from your lecture slides for faster note-taking in Markdown or Typst
author: Joel-dev-IMP

apograph.supportedLanguages.description: Languages, where Apograph will be enabled.

apograph.pdfPath.description: Path to the PDF, where the completion items should be extracted from.

apograph.excalidraw.defaultName.title: Default File Name
apograph.excalidraw.defaultName.description: The default file name for new Excalidraw Files. This filename will be suggested when creating a new Excalidraw image. Supports dates using Python strftime syntax.

apograph.excalidraw.imageLocation.title: Image Location
apograph.excalidraw.imageLocation.description: Specify, where you want to store your Excalidraw Files. Absolute paths and paths relative to the active file are supported. If the path does not exist, it will be created.

apograph.drawio.defaultName.title: Default File Name
apograph.drawio.defaultName.description: The default file name for new Draw IO Files. This filename will be suggested when creating a new Draw IO image. Supports dates using Python strftime syntax.

apograph.drawio.imageLocation.title: Image Location
apograph.drawio.imageLocation.description: Specify, where you want to store your Draw IO Files. Absolute paths and paths relative to the active file are supported. If the path does not exist, it will be created.

apograph.debug.generateProcessingOutput.title: Create Processing output
apograph.debug.generateProcessingOutput.description: Write the output of the PDF processing to a JSON file

apograph.experimental.enableLineCompleti.title: Enable Line Completion
apograph.experimental.enableLineCompleti.description: Enable the completion of entire lines of text

scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
